holy_fool_action: allowing the father to leave while she still wants him to stay

markers.name: HF_ANCESTOR_AT_EXIT
markers.note: Near doorway / Zone-table threshold; incomplete warning presence; loving, fallible, implicated — not a supernatural judge or oracle.

markers.name: HF_LOOK_ANCESTOR_TO_FATHER
markers.action: looking from the ancestor to her father
markers.note: Eyeline A (exit / ancestor) then B (father at table). Choice becomes visible in the turn of the head — no dialogue required.

markers.name: HF_FATHER_TENDER_PERSONAL
markers.action: the father remaining tender and personal
markers.note: Still specific: habit, warmth, unfinished phrase — not a digital mask or monster. Temptation remains beautiful so release costs.

markers.name: HF_ANCESTOR_NOT_ORACLE
markers.action: the ancestor refusing to become an oracle
markers.note: No explanation; no nod that means 'do this and you are saved.' Presence only. If he moves, it is leave-taking, not prophecy.

markers.name: HF_RELEASE_CONTROL
markers.note: Fingers lift from PROP_PlaybackControl. Ordinary. Costly. Want remains on her face while the hand opens. Camera: CAM_TABLE_OINO_CONTROL then widen.

markers.name: HF_SEQUENCE_FORWARD
markers.note: No rewind. Time resumes living direction. Loop authority ends with the open hand.

markers.name: HF_FATHER_FINISHES_MELODY
markers.note: Unfinished melody reaches its natural end once — not an endless perfect take. Include the familiar mistake if it still belongs to him.

markers.name: HF_FATHER_STANDS_LEAVES
markers.note: Weight up from habitual chair; path toward window or door. CAM_TABLE_FATHER_LEAVING. She does not reset.

markers.name: HF_LISTEN_SOUND_AND_SILENCE
markers.action: Oino listening through the final sound and the silence after it
markers.note: Hold on her listening — last note, decay, then silence that is allowed to remain empty. Patient camera; do not fill with score sting.

markers.name: HF_CARRY_RECORDING_OUT
markers.note: She takes the recording / playback object as memory to share — not as a loop engine. Gift moves toward nourishment (home / sister), not endless extraction.

markers.name: HF_LOOK_BACK_THRESHOLD
markers.action: one look back at the threshold without commanding a return
markers.note: CAM_TABLE_DOORWAY_LOOKBACK. One look. No gesture that rewinds, summons, or resets. Empty space may hold after she turns away.

markers.name: HF_DIONYSUS_REL_DUST_TO_WHITE_BIRDS
markers.image: dust or film perforations become white birds
markers.note: Dust / sprocket holes lift into dove-like forms as he leaves — brief; not a god exit bow.
